name: local-live-captions
description: Firefox add-on that shows live English captions for any audio playing in a tab, using a local Whisper model.

scripts.start: npm run vendor && web-ext run --source-dir extension --browser-console
scripts.sign: npm run vendor && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --channel unlisted
scripts.test: node test/throttle.test.mjs && node test/settings.test.mjs && node test/timeline.test.mjs
